statusLine.command: input=$(cat); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir // .cwd'); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); pct=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); out="$model | ${cwd##*/}"; br=$(git -C "$cwd" --no-optional-locks branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$br" ] && out="$out | $br"; [ -n "$pct" ] && out="$out | ctx $(printf '%.0f' "$pct")%"; echo "$out"
